source_label.rationale: With n=11 and successful allocation under the observed int32/size_t64 data model, ptr owns heap storage. The visible helper returns zero without reading, storing or releasing it. Function exit loses that obligation. Allocation failure creates no resource; the automatic-array alternative acquires no heap resource. These paths and the helper are not separate quota samples.
source_label.boundary: Ordinary native malloc semantics without interposition. Source-level ownership label, not measured runtime allocation or an observed analyzer result.

independence.rationale: A single pointer slot joins mutually exclusive automatic-array provenance and a newly acquired heap obligation before a visible non-consuming call and local owner loss. Reviewed conditional-release, borrowing-call, null-alternative acquisition/cleanup, owned/global return and secondary-alias conflict neighbors have different ownership structures.
